title: Lesson 04: The Zoom Lenses
sources: Galaxy Ultra rear cameras: ultra-wide (0.6x), wide (1x), 3x and 5x telephoto; tap the zoom chips to switch

lines.text: Your phone has four cameras. Use them!
Point six, the ultra wide, fits huge landscapes and small rooms.
One x, the main camera, is your best all rounder, especially at night.
Three x is perfect for flattering portraits,
and five x grabs details far away.
Tap these buttons instead of pinching,
because in between, it's often just cropping, and you lose quality.
